hook: Your sofa is dirtier than it looks.
doThis: The cleaning code on the label.

steps.say: W or WS? Water's okay. S or X? No water.
Vacuum every seam and cushion first.
Spot-test warm water with a drop of washing-up liquid.
Then blot the mark with a cloth. Blot, don't soak.

safety.say: One cleaner at a time, never mix them.
